rivers.name: Río Torres
rivers.relief_method: Lower of maximum terrain on each side (80–600 m) minus DEM at river crossing. Not cliff height, track clearance or a surveyed cross-section.
rivers.art_direction: River below bridge; high rocky canyon walls with local vegetation where reference confirms exposed rock; preserve approach slopes and land support.
